resources.string: Gemini Nano is not available on this device. You need a 2026 flagship phone with ≥12GB of RAM (e.g. Pixel 10 or Galaxy S26) and up-to-date Google Play Services.
This device does not have enough RAM (~4GB+) to run a local Gemma model with MediaPipe.
GEMINI_API_KEY is not configured in local.properties, or there is no internet connection.
This device does not have enough RAM (~6GB+) to run Gemma 4 with LiteRT-LM.
FIREBASE_API_KEY, FIREBASE_APP_ID and FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID are not configured in local.properties (from a Firebase project with Firebase AI Logic enabled), or there is no internet connection.
The model is available but has not been downloaded yet.
The Gemma model (.task) is missing — it can be downloaded (a few hundred MB).
The Gemma 4 E2B model (.litertlm, ~2.6 GB) is missing — it downloads directly from Hugging Face, no login.
